summary: A placeholder for content that has not arrived yet, in three shapes and two tones, with a pulse you can stagger or switch off.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius, plus a default size: `line` for text, `block` for a control or thumbnail, `circle` for an avatar. Override the size with `className`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `subtle` is one step lighter, for the secondary line in a pair.

props.name: animate
props.description: The pulse. Turn it off for a static placeholder, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to offset the pulse by. Stagger a list with `delay={index * 0.15}` so its rows do not beat in unison.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended after the generated classes, so the width and height you pass win over the shape's defaults.
